description: This file defines a controller class 'RequestPasswordFailureController' within the OrangeHRM authentication plugin. It manages the presentation of a password reset failure page by setting a specific template and component when handling requests.

classes.name: RequestPasswordFailureController
classes.description: A controller class responsible for handling password reset failure views, extending AbstractVueController and implementing PublicControllerInterface.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the view by setting the template and component to inform the user about password reset failure.
